---
title: "Performance of understory vs gap seedlings in the old-growth forest"
---

```{r setup}
#| include: false

document_name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(
	basename(knitr::current_input())
)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
	fig.path = file.path("figures", document_name, "")
)

set.seed(as.numeric(Sys.Date()))

ggplot2::theme_set(ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = 15))
```

R1.14: The authors refer to seedlings planted under shade as well as in canopy gaps. It could be interesting to see these understorey planted seedlings in the SI, as it may reveal something on light requirements for successful planting

```{r}
library("tidyverse")
library("patchwork")

clean_data <- read_rds(here::here(
	"data",
	"derived",
	"data_cleaned_incl_understory.rds"
)) |>
	filter(forest_type == "primary")

surv_data <- read_rds(here::here(
	"data",
	"derived",
	"data_survival_incl_understory.rds"
)) |>
	filter(forest_type == "primary")
```

## Survival

```{r}
p_survival <-
	clean_data |>
	mutate(canopy = ifelse(canopy == "G", "Gap", "Understory")) |>
	mutate(survival = as.factor(survival)) |>
	ggplot(aes(x = census_no, group = survival, fill = survival)) +
	geom_bar(alpha = 0.75) +
	facet_wrap(~canopy, ncol = 1, axis.labels = "all_x", axes = "all_x") +
	guides(x = guide_axis(angle = 90)) +
	scale_fill_manual(values = c("grey", "#009e73")) +
	theme(legend.position = "top", legend.justification = "left") +
	labs(
		x = "Census number",
		y = "Count of seedlings",
		fill = "Survival"
	)
```

## Growth

```{r}
p_growth <-
	clean_data |>
	mutate(canopy = ifelse(canopy == "G", "Gap", "Understory")) |>
	ggplot(aes(y = log(dbase_mean), x = years)) +
	geom_point(alpha = 0.25, shape = 20, colour = "#009e73") +
	theme(legend.position = "top", legend.justification = "left") +
	labs(
		x = "Years since first measurment",
		y = "log Basal diameter (mm)",
		title = "Old-growth forest seedlings, planted in:"
	) +
	facet_wrap(~canopy)
```

## Combine

```{r}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 10

p_growth / p_survival + plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a")
```
